name: AI 交互工作台
positioning: 适合对话分析、会话回放、情绪标注和 AI 协作工作台类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.shadow_style: 柔和低对比阴影配合粉、紫、桃和薄荷色层级；不复制品牌或真实产品资产。

layout_rules: Map every visible sidebar item to one complete top-level page view; show exactly one page at a time and never scroll between sidebar pages.
Keep the demo self-contained in one HTML file plus local CSS and JavaScript assets; no build step and no network fetch at runtime.
Use a fixed or off-canvas sidebar only as a web navigation pattern, not as native desktop chrome.
Keep top actions limited to buttons that produce real observable results such as export, refresh, navigation, form filtering, drawer open, dialog confirmation, save or reset.
Preserve the selected template's visual language through color, spacing, card treatment, corner radius, and information rhythm.

component_inventory.name: page_view
component_inventory.use_for: complete web pages inside a single HTML file

interaction_contracts: Every visible enabled control must have an observable result; omit unfinished controls or expose them as truly disabled with a reason.
Sidebar navigation must update aria-current, breadcrumb text, document title, URL hash, and visible page content.
Filtering must update result count and show an explicit empty state.
Export must generate a non-empty CSV file for the current filtered mock state.
Drawer and dialog flows must support Escape, cancel without mutation, focus restoration, and visible success feedback after confirmation.
Settings save and reset must mutate current demo state rather than showing fake success only.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep controls keyboard reachable.

preserve: 明确的本地 Mock 标识
replace_from_development_document: record noun, statuses, filters, table columns, mock records, and drawer fields
overview metrics, chart labels, insights grouping, workspace roles, and setting labels
avoid: third-party logos, brand names, screenshots, images, product copy, icons, or source code
native desktop window chrome, external dependencies, or placeholder buttons with no visible result
using color alone to communicate state

single_file_compilation.style_source: inline the complete contents of tokens.css into a style element
single_file_compilation.script_source: inline the complete contents of interactions.js before the closing body tag
single_file_compilation.asset_policy: use inline SVG and CSS shapes only; do not introduce external URLs
